claims: The Artemis II astronauts successfully splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The splashdown occurred on Friday evening, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II mission was a 10-day moon mission.
The Artemis II crew was retrieved by the USS John P. Murtha recovery ship.
The splashdown time was 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
The Artemis II crew consisted of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
